decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits close to the core pipeline-fittings business and was upgraded to its own page in 2019, so it likely meets aspirations in a growing industry and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The powder-coated public waste bin is far from the core business, but it uses the firm's existing coating and fabrication equipment and sells to municipal customers it already serves, so industry growth and slack let the firm carry it despite uncertain results.

The waste bin with ashtray is a niche variant distant from the core, but it shares production and customers with the bin line, so it is cheap to keep while results remain unproven, though it is vulnerable if street-furniture sales fall short.

The outdoor ashtrays are distant from the core and face a shrinking smoking market, which raises the risk of falling short, but low carrying costs on existing coating capacity and the firm's slack argue for keeping them for now.
